authority: Agent-authored under CLAUDE.md, recording decisions the operator gave in session on 2026-10-14. Advisory, out-of-band QA. Closes no gate, adds no runtime gate and amends no constitutional rule.
decided_by: the operator, answering each of O1 to O6 in session on 2026-10-14
decision: O1 to O5 adopt the handoff's defaults. O6 approves the harness Bedrock Converse backend as a change to the blind lane's transport, for the harness only.
why: The handoff left six decisions open. AN1a, AN2, AN4 and AN-P each wait on one or more of them.
inputs: plans/msca_dn_anonymisation_handoff_2026-10-14.md section 9 (the harness cannot build a Bedrock backend)

privacy.claim: This record holds no private content: no names, institutions, acronyms, research groups, locations, figures or text from the submitted original or its derivatives.
privacy.basis: Every answer is a choice among the handoff's own generic options.

answer_kinds.operator_adopted_default: The operator was offered the handoff's default and chose it.
answer_kinds.operator_answer: The handoff gives no default, and the operator answered.

decisions.question: Edit the Word source or the submitted PDF?
decisions.answer: Edit the Word source if it renders to the submitted PDF. Otherwise edit the submitted PDF in place.
decisions.consequence: AN4 makes the render check, and the route follows from its result.

decisions.question: Which Bedrock model for A3, and which different one for A5?
decisions.answer: A3 (span-edit rewrite) uses the pinned assessor model. A5 (closed-book model attack) uses a different member of the Claude family.
decisions.consequence: AN6 pins the A3 model id. AN8b pins the A5 model id and refuses to run with the A3 model, as its own acceptance criterion requires.
decisions.open_part: The A5 model id is not chosen. See known_gaps.

decisions.question: Re-identification threshold: zero correct guesses per category, or a tolerance?
decisions.answer: Zero correct guesses for institutions, people and the acronym. The country set may be guessed when the policy keeps it.
decisions.consequence: AN8b fails on any correct guess of an institution, a person or the acronym.
decisions.open_part: The attack also guesses the research group, and the default does not set its threshold. See known_gaps.

decisions.question: Which locations are kept at country level, given that MSCA scoring reads the network's geography?
decisions.answer: Generalise every location below country level. Keep each participant's EU, associated-country or third-country status.
decisions.consequence: AN2 writes this rule into the public policy.

decisions.question: Run the FIELDWISE pilot first?
decisions.answer: No. The pilot does not run unless the fellow agrees.
decisions.consequence: AN-P stays parked. The fellow's agreement must be recorded before any pilot run.

decisions.question: Approve the harness Bedrock Converse backend (handoff section 9) as a change to the blind lane's transport?
decisions.approved_before_an1: Yes. No AN1a, AN1b or AN1c work exists on the branch when this record is written.
decisions.scope: The harness blind assessor may use a bedrock-converse transport on AWS, under the ADR-001 controls the handoff lists. The approval covers the harness only. It does not re-point the runner's transport preset, and the local configuration stays on the Claude subscription.
conditions: AN1a: the judge builds the Converse backend with the pinned model, temperature and token limit. The existing claude-cli and openai-compatible routes behave as before.
AN1b: the freeze gains a bedrock-converse isolation entry, and the V13 receipt records the transport actually used.
AN1c: the judge-independence rule is re-checked for a drafter and an assessor that share a provider.
Each of AN1a to AN1c is tested at the level V13 set (handoff section 9).

known_gaps.gap: The A3 and A5 Bedrock model ids are not named. AN6 and AN8b must record them before either runs.
The handoff's attack also names the research group, and the default sets no threshold for it. AN8b must not run until the operator sets one.

not_evidence_of: Any implementation of AN1a to AN1c, or that the Bedrock backend works.
That a Word source exists or renders to the submitted PDF.
The fellow's agreement to a FIELDWISE pilot.
stays_blocked: AN-P: needs AN11, and O5 answered yes
